T: Say the word. Pass the plate.
D: A foster kid in Philadelphia can turn into a grown-up superhero just by saying one word.
P: Serve the mains when the Vasquez foster family sits down to dinner together.
S: Billy's new foster home in Philadelphia
Rib eye frozen 30 minutes, shaved thin, seared with onions, provolone melted over the top, piled onto toasted mini rolls.
Freddy's the brains of the operation
Crisp potato gems baked hot and tossed with garlic salt and parmesan, with tomato sauce.
the fight at the Christmas carnival

Little yeasted ring doughnuts fried golden and fluffy, rolled hot in cinnamon sugar and served in paper bags with warm chocolate sauce. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 50g sugar, 1 egg, 40g soft butter and 200ml warm milk into a soft dough, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll out 1cm thick and cut 20 small rings. Prove 20 minutes, then fry at 175C for 1 minute a side until golden. Toss hot in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Melt 100g chocolate with 100ml cream for dipping.
M: Saffron yellow rice baked in one big pot with browned chicken thighs, capsicum, peas and green olives, finished with lime and coriander. Brown 1kg chicken thighs, then soften 1 onion and 1 red capsicum. Add 300g rice, a pinch of saffron, 1 tsp paprika and 750ml stock and nestle in the chicken. Cover and bake at 180C for 35 minutes, then stir through 100g peas and olives.
Freddy filming Billy testing out his powers

Thin pizza bases spread with tomato sauce, loaded with mozzarella and pepperoni, baked blistered and crisp, with chilli flakes and parmesan. Divide 1kg pizza dough into 4 and stretch into thin rounds. Mix 250ml passata with 1 tsp dried oregano, a pinch of sugar and salt and spread over the bases. Top with 400g grated mozzarella and 200g sliced pepperoni. Bake on hot trays at 250C for 10 minutes until blistered and bubbling. Finish with grated parmesan and chilli flakes for whoever wants them.
W: the Rock of Eternity where Billy meets the wizard
Dark chocolate rocky road with marshmallows, roasted almonds and broken biscuits, set and cut into chunks.
K: Rich, creamy eggnog cooked into a light custard with cinnamon and vanilla, chilled and topped with whipped cream and fresh nutmeg. Whisk 4 egg yolks with 80g caster sugar until pale. Heat 600ml milk and 200ml cream with 1 cinnamon stick and 1 tsp vanilla until steaming, then whisk slowly into the yolks. Return to the pan and stir over low heat for 5 minutes until it coats a spoon, without boiling. Strain, chill for 3 hours, then pour into 4 glasses, top with whipped cream and grate over nutmeg.
